verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS research tool like Elicit, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented setting or policy for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. A community complaint about unsolicited follow-up emails concerns marketing email, not telemetry, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
